P.text: A new user stakes TRUST purely for yield and does not interact with the MultiVault; on their first claim, rawUtilizationDelta mathematically evaluates to 0.
P.evidence_quote: When a new user stakes TRUST purely for yield and does not interact with the MultiVault, their rawUtilizationDelta for their first epoch mathematically evaluates to 0.

I.text: New users are intended to be exempt from the utilization penalty on their first claim when they had nothing claimable last epoch.
I.evidence_quote: the developers explicitly intended to exempt new users from this penalty on their first claim. As noted in the comments at line 527: "If the user had nothing claimable last epoch, don't penalize them as it's their first ever claim."

V.text: The strict penalty check (rawUtilizationDelta <= 0) is evaluated before the first-claim exemption check, so the exemption is unreachable and the personalUtilizationLowerBound is applied, destroying up to 75% of first-epoch matured yield.
V.evidence_quote: The strict penalty check (rawUtilizationDelta <= 0) is evaluated before the first-claim exemption check (userUtilizationTarget == 0).
